title: Dolphins agree to deals with Joshua Uche, Alex Austin, Ben Sims and Lonnie Johnson

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Dolphins agree to deals with Joshua Uche, Alex Austin, Ben Sims and Lonnie Johnson
sources.description: The Dolphins made a big splash by agreeing to sign quarterback Malik Willis in the early hours of free agency on Monday and they moved on to filling out the rest of the roster on Wednesday.
